senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חָסַל) [to scrape off,] to diminish, take off; to be diminished, less; to want, miss; to be imperfect.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 68a:5">Snh. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא חָסַרְתִּי מרבותי וכ׳</he> yet I skimmed of the knowledge of my teachers no more than a dog takes who licks out of the sea.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 68a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>ולא חֲסָרוּנִי וכ׳</he> they skimmed of my knowledge &c.; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3:1">Cant. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>לא חֲסַרְתִּיהָ וכ׳</he> what wisdom I skimmed of the Law, was no more than &c., v. <cite ref="G00471"><he>זַכְרוּת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3:1">Ib.</cite> <he>רבותי חֲסָרוּהָ וכ׳</he> my teachers carried off at least a real smattering of it &c.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 20a:19">B. Kam. 20ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מאי חֲסַרְתִּיךָ</he> what loss have I occasioned to thee?—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 20b:3">Ib.ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>זה נהנה … חָסֵר</he> the one profits while the other loses nothing (therefore can claim no damages).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1:6">Lev. R. s. 1</cite> <he>מה חָסַרְתָּ</he>, v. <cite ref="D00943"><he>דֵּעָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Menachot 30a:7">Men. 30ᵃ</cite>, a. e. is it possible <he>ס״ת ח׳ אות וכ׳</he> that the Book of the Law wanted one letter yet (to be written) &c.?—
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3:1">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to <he>מתה עלי</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 48:7">Gen. XLVIII, 7</cite>) <he>שחֲסרְתִּיהָ</he> for I miss her; a. fr.
<cite ref="Keritot 6a:49">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>חי׳ אחת וכ׳</he> if he left out one of its ingredients.
<cite ref="Eruvin 13a:9">Erub. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>שמא אתה מְחַסֵּר וכ׳</he> for if thou omit one letter.

Koh. R. to I, 15 (ref. to חסרון, ib.) משאדם מְחַ׳ עצמו וכ׳ as soon as a man deprives himself of the words of the Law (neglecting them); ib. מַחֲסִיר (Hif.). Y. Snh. XI, beg. 30ᵃ אפי׳ לא חי׳ even if on inflicting an injury (v. חַבּוּרָה) he did not create a diminution (open wound); a. fr.—Part. pass. מְחוּסָּר, constr. מְחוּסַּר wanting, requiring.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 6a">R. Hash. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>מח׳ זמן</he> wanting time, i.e. too young for sacrifice.
<cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 2:1">Ker. II, 1</cite> <he>מח׳ כפרה</he> requires a ceremony of atonement (before he may partake of a sacred meal).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">Gen. R. s. 32</cite>, a. e. <he>מח׳ אמנה</he>, v. <cite ref="A02042"><he>אֲמָנָה</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 25a:13">Ḥull. 25ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00627"><he>חֲטִיטָה</he></cite>.—Y. B. Mets. V, 10ᶜ bot. <he>מח׳ מעשה אחד</he> wanting one action to be available; a. fr.—Pl. constr. <he>מְחוּסְּרֵי</he>. Ker. l. c. <he>ארבעה מ׳ וכ׳</he> there are four persons requiring a ceremony of atonement before being permitted &c., v. supra; a. fr.
